title: Fix SQL injection in the user repository
description: `users_repo.py` builds SQL strings by interpolating user input, which allows SQL injection. Fix every function so untrusted values can never change the query structure: use parameterized queries for values, and a strict allow-list for anything that cannot be parameterized (column names, sort direction). The documented behaviour (including the validation rules in the docstrings) must hold; `test_users_repo.py` includes injection attempts.
